backbone: M0 / Version-A Random Forest retained as the immutable recognition control; Version-B contribution is the adaptive authorization/profile/security layer.

recognition_control.interpretation: same frozen RF recognizer; no unsupported backbone gain claimed

evidence_boundary: Replay and gain-drift improvements are demonstrated controlled/derived scenarios. Target-like unknown contamination remains a known weakness. No poisoning-resistance claim is made beyond measured replay/gain behaviour.
b1_b2: candidate-model benchmark remains uncertified; no candidate accuracy is fabricated. The V-B security-core is frozen around the proven M0 recognizer so the UI can be completed without contaminating the scientific record.
freeze_rule: After this milestone, UI work may change presentation, deployment and visualization but must not alter frozen experiment numbers without a new dated experiment artifact.
